name: August
title: A growth system that connects channels to the client
subtitle: Acquisition engineering · Partnerships · Attribution
focus: Build the measurement and workflow layer across search, referrals, outbound and a law firm’s first useful conversation.
priorities: Build pipelines and automations across GTM tools and HubSpot APIs.
Instrument acquisition, referrals and funnel performance with PostHog / Statsig.
Improve search and paid acquisition using SEO, Search Console and Google Ads context.
Support the partnership and services growth model with useful, relevant outreach.
layers: Search intent, referral identifiers, outbound and paid campaign context.
Firm, practice group and contact identity with source and consent context.
Preserve first touch, assisted touches and the qualified-conversation outcome.
Use channel and experiment evidence to refine content, outreach and partner handoffs.
rules: Public practice information is sufficient for research; do not infer confidential client matters.
A referral needs its own identifier and a verified relationship.
An attribution model assigns credit; it does not prove incrementality.

personas.name: Practice leader
personas.pain: Finding a useful AI workflow within the practice’s actual work
personas.promise: A practice-specific discovery conversation using public context only.
personas.subject: A question about {{practice}} workflows
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, I saw your firm’s public work in {{practice}}. I’d like to understand one recurring knowledge or document workflow your team would find useful to improve. Where does that work slow down today?
personas.question: Which workflow would be useful to examine without bringing in confidential matter details?

personas.name: Managing partner / operations
personas.pain: Evaluating a new workflow and commercial partnership across the firm
personas.promise: A scoped evaluation with operational ownership and clear partnership questions.
personas.subject: A focused conversation for {{firm}}
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, before proposing a broad AI initiative, I’d start with one practice workflow, a responsible owner and a way to judge usefulness. Would it help to map that process and the partnership questions together?
personas.question: Who should own workflow adoption and review the commercial arrangement?

pitch: I combine startup positioning and outbound experience with hands-on product and data building. I have built a local CRM with contact provenance and campaign drafts, product analytics and customer inquiry workflows. At August, I would bring those pieces together across acquisition channels, relevant firm research and a measurable path to a useful partner conversation.
mappings: PostHog funnel work and a local partnership CRM.
Join search, referrals and campaign activity to qualified conversations.
Next.js / React / Node / Supabase product and commercial workflows.
Build a narrow, reliable lifecycle integration with explicit receipts.
Startup positioning, messaging, outbound and enterprise selling.
Start from the practice’s public work and a useful question.
northStar: Qualified conversations with understandable acquisition history
days60: Extend the measurement model across outbound and paid acquisition; improve a practice-specific landing page and booking path.
days90: Scale channels and partner workflows from qualified outcomes, with attribution and incrementality treated as different questions.
